approvalScope: One frozen Swift source-authored consumer and compatibility with current production APIs; not whole producer/controls integration or an SDK execution pass.
inputAdmission: Required separate Bundle JSON and URL IPA; missing metadata/archive throws, with no skip, embedded base64 fallback or synthetic minimal-app substitution. Metadata is a regular file bounded1MiB; archive retains existing536870912-byte budget.

Metadata source hash is lower-hex and matches actual main Simulator host full40/short7 stamps. Input and output actual main/widget/share Info plists match that source and iPhoneOS platform; exact three bundle paths and unique bounded actual component paths are required.

Existing Unpacker first verifies actual archive hash/size, code/profile signatures, resource envelopes and nested component inventories under the supplied controlled trust. Each component must be a single arm64 thin64 Mach-O with actual LC_BUILD_VERSION platform IOS; no platform bytes are rewritten.

JDK class count exactly equals metadata and exceeds10000, ordinary Jar exactSHA/size plus runtime-manifest match, Notices exist, two actual java.base classes have CAFEBABE headers, and packaged java-home directory is rejected.
productionPathAndOutput: Exactly one existing production Vault creates an owned namespace and permanent key, derives a public certificate/profile set using the existing ephemeral PKI fixture, publishes the same original three bundle identities, then invokes SelfRenewalControlledPackageSigner.resign on the actual IPA. No new signer/store/HTTP/VM or exported private key.

The production signer itself validates the live Lease, preserves identity/entitlements, signs actual nested code, re-verifies whole resources and emits a pinned ControlledArchive. The test checks original archive binding, all component changes, app-group/keychain identity preservation and explicit false authority flags.
Actual output is read through ControlledArchive.read in existing65536-byte chunks, with exact lengths and incremental SHA256 equal to output archive.sha256, then synchronized/closed as a real file.

A separate new Unpacker.withOwnedApplication invocation opens that output URL under replacement anchors and verifies its exact archive hash/size and complete Materials equality. It repeats device/JVM/resource checks from those newly read bytes.

Input and output full file-path sets must match. All runtime hashes match; every file outside actual executable, embedded profile and CodeResources paths must retain its input hash. Frameworks are accepted only if actually present and must be preserved; none is synthesized to claim a fourth component.
lifecycleAndAPIReview: Heavy work runs in Task.detached utility, with main-thread precondition and bounded SourcePerfTrace details. Task cancellation propagates to that worker; streaming and component loops check cancellation; existing Unpacker/Signer worker cancellation/drain semantics are retained.

Output FileHandle closes on both success/error. After namespace creation, all failure/cancellation paths attempt the same cleanup; cleanup uses an independent uncancelled detached Task, obtains current Vault generation and destroys only that namespace, removes only its UUID-owned temporary directory, and surfaces cleanup errors.

Existing PKI issuer is explicitly nonpersistent. The signing key is the Vault-owned permanent key and is destroyed through that owner. ControlledArchive retains a read-only Snapshot whose deinit closes the descriptor; no mutable staging path escapes its owned scope.

Called APIs, labels and inspected fields exist in the exact current10 declared dependency sources plus four additional read sources. Generic OwnedApplication closure return values are Sendable tuples/dictionaries/materials. No definite Swift symbol, static-helper qualification, short-circuit throwing RHS or actor-call mismatch was found from source inspection; this is not typechecking.
producerAndMetadataBoundary: originalBuildManifest and sameJobNativeReuse are only bounded size/hash facts in this Swift resource. Actual manifest bytes, same-job provenance and device-build preservation must be enforced by the separately frozen producer/controller; this consumer alone does not authenticate unseen records.

Producer wire was compared only for the exact currently stated metadata/body/resource names; mutable producer code was not approved here. Whole production/controller snapshot, compulsory resource installation and exact selector/source closure still require independent integration review.

The input controlled trust and replacement PKI are test-only synthetic authority. They do not establish Apple certificate/team permission, provisioning service approval, installed device eligibility, code replacement permission or automatic renewal.
remainingExecutionLimits: Apple SDK still must compile and execute this exact new method against the full current-source iPhoneOS/JVM package; possible real-layout/budget/CodeResources/entitlement rejection remains a failure, not a skip or unsupported acceptance.

No deliberate mid-sign cancellation is driven by this one new positive method; source cleanup/cancellation uses existing production behavior, and the existing controlled signer cancellation regressions remain separate evidence.
A pass would establish controlled complete-package signing and independent byte verification only, not install/session/physical-device/unattended renewal.
